name: Chapter opener
description: An eyebrow, a title and a first paragraph — the standard way to start a chapter.

name: Pull quote
description: Something worth setting apart, with an attribution underneath.

content.text: Something they said that you never forgot.

name: Letter opening
description: A centred greeting and an opening line, for the very top of an experience.

content.text: I could have sent a message. This felt closer to what I meant.

name: Then and now
description: Two short passages side by side — who they were, and who they are now.

content.text: Then: write who they were back then — one specific detail that's changed since.
Now: write who they are now. Let the contrast do the work — no need to spell it out.

name: A list of reasons
description: A short, specific list — the reasons, out of many, worth naming.

content.text: A few reasons, out of many

1. The first reason — be specific, not general.
2. The second.
3. The third.

Keep going for as long as it's true.
